management.src: If the near leg's short delta exceeds 0.80 before expiry, close the pair - the assignment risk now exceeds the arbitrage edge.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the near leg is short and American; close it by 15:30 ET on its expiration day, always.
Close the near leg at extrinsic < $0.10 or |delta| >= 0.85, and before any ex-dividend date while a short call is ITM.
Close the near leg at extrinsic < $0.10 or |delta| >= 0.85, and before any ex-dividend date while a short call is ITM.

unexpressed.text: VIOLATION TEST, ON EXECUTABLE PRICES ONLY: near-expiry BID at strike K must exceed far-expiry ASK at the same strike and same right, by more than total round-trip costs. Mid prices do not count; a violation that disappears at the touch never existed.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Minimum edge: (near bid - far ask) x 100 >= $15 per contract after commissions, or skip it.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Quote freshness: both legs must have traded or updated within 60 seconds and both must show size >= 10 contracts.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Both legs same strike, same right, same underlying. Any strike or right mismatch makes this an ordinary calendar spread, not an arbitrage.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Dividend check: if an ex-dividend date falls between the two expiries, recompute - a large expected dividend legitimately makes the near call cheaper and the near put richer, and most apparent violations are exactly this.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Hard-to-borrow check: an elevated borrow rate can also explain the inversion legitimately; if the borrow rate exceeds 5% annualized, reject.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Submit as one MLeg order only. Never leg it - legging turns a riskless trade into a directional one.
unexpressed.reason: order mechanics: owned by optexec, not by the IR

unexpressed.text: Hold to the near expiry, then decide on the far leg as a standalone position.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Close both legs immediately if the spread reverts to normal and the credit can be banked early with more than 50% of the edge captured.
unexpressed.reason: an exit or stop this compiler could not express

unexpressed.text: Never add size to a violation that persists; a persisting violation is almost always a data error.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: If the near leg is assigned, exercise or sell the far leg in the same session to flatten the resulting share position, and log it as an incident.
unexpressed.reason: assignment prose: the machine-readable part is the guard, which is compiled separately where the sentence gives a time or a threshold

unexpressed.text: Never hold the far leg unhedged overnight after an unexpected assignment.
unexpressed.reason: assignment prose: the machine-readable part is the guard, which is compiled separately where the sentence gives a time or a threshold

safety_gaps.why: a short call plus a dividend rule in the document, and no compiled guard. A short call with less extrinsic than the dividend is exercised the night before the ex-date.
